items.award: Level A up to $10,000, Level B up to $5,000
items.summary: Awards for advanced Yukon artists, with two intakes each year.

items.title: Guggenheim Fellowships
items.eligibility: Mid-career U.S. and Canadian citizens and permanent residents in the arts, humanities and sciences, including writing
items.deadlineNote: The 2027 application is closed, the next deadline is not stated yet
items.award: Not stated
items.summary: Annual fellowships for mid-career writers and artists in the U.S. and Canada.

items.title: Hodder Fellowship
items.eligibility: Writers, translators and other artists of exceptional promise, usually with one book published, U.S. citizenship not required
items.deadlineNote: 11:59 p.m. Eastern
items.award: $93,000 stipend for ten months
items.summary: An annual ten-month fellowship for writers and translators of exceptional promise.

items.title: Ruth Lilly and Dorothy Sargent Rosenberg Poetry Fellowships
items.eligibility: Poets aged 21 to 31 in 2027 who are U.S. citizens or residents
items.deadlineNote: Applications open January 15, 2027, deadline 5 p.m. Central
items.award: $27,000 each, five fellowships
items.summary: Apply with 10 pages of poetry. Five young poets receive fellowships each year.

items.title: Freedom to Read Week
items.eligibility: Open to everyone, see the get-involved page
items.deadlineNote: Held in late February, the 2026 week ran February 22 to 28
items.award: Free promotional materials and ideas for taking part
items.summary: An annual Canada-wide week in late February. Free materials and get-involved tips are on the official site.
